deepsweSource.title: Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index v1.5 — DeepSWE v1.1
deepsweSource.methodology: The chart states each benchmark score averages pass@1 across three attempts per task.
deepsweSource.captureMethod: Built-in browser rendered public chart with Select all: 31 of 31 configurations. Public scores are rounded; Download data requires Artificial Analysis Pro. The earlier capture date is retained on previously recorded rows.

cohort.source: Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index v1.5 DeepSWE v1.1 chart

frontierSelection.chartTitle: Intelligence Index vs. Cost to Run Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
frontierSelection.costUnit: USD to run all Intelligence Index evaluations

completeness.note: All 691 catalog models selected; 173 plotted points and all 14 Pareto path vertices captured. Public tooltips supply rounded integer Intelligence Index and two-decimal USD total cost. No hidden state or paid export used.

bugHuntEmphasisRanking.benchmarkVersion: 105 planted bugs across two repositories; rolling public results snapshot

excludedResults.exclusionReason: Benchmark owner evaluated high effort; the cohort selects the medium variant.
Two repository legs used different serving routes. The owner run notes identify the 14/105 OpenRouter row as the single-route result.

providerClaimAudit.searchQuery: "Bug Hunt Bench" ("GPT-5.5" OR "Gemini 3.7 Flash" OR "Gemini 3.6 Flash" OR "GLM-5.2" OR "Gemini 3.5 Flash")
providerClaimAudit.note: The focused search surfaced third-party discussion but no matching provider-hosted score for the unmatched cohort entries; no values are imputed.

models.name: GPT-6.1 Sol

bugHunt.effortStatus: verified first-party tier; below ultra ceiling
bugHunt.note: Owner-published mean of three identical Max configurations; 44.3/105 is the owner's published one-decimal mean. Codex0.159.0 differs from older OpenAI rows; max is below ultra. Some laptop load may inflate wall time. Cost is a list-rate estimate, not an invoice; no retained request reached long-context rates. Earlier sandbox-blocked attempt voided and excluded; extras65.3 are unscored.

deepsweScoreConfig.matchNote: Exact Codex GPT-6.1 Sol Max owner row selected from all configurations; public chart 70 is rounded, 113 tasks with three attempts per task. Evaluation date and higher precision are not publicly exposed in the inspected row.

extraction.note: Capture retained at the stated timestamp from primary-agent public browser observations collected shortly beforehand (approximately 16:20 UTC). Total benchmark cost 1081.55 is distinct from displayed cost per task 0.72. Normalized displays are retained directly and are not inverted into raw Elo values. Briefcase 1564 and GDPval-AA v2.1 1575 are observed whole-number public Elo labels. Cached-input price is derived from publicly displayed input price 2 USD/M and 95% cache discount; it is not a separately displayed price observation.
extraction.method: Primary agent observed exact max official model profile in the built-in browser; frontier worker observed the exact max total benchmark cost tooltip. No hidden page state or API fetch used.
